profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a for-profit public company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, according to its profile. Its Japanese-language site describes itself as the official site of SoftBank Group Corp., whose representative director, chairman and president executive officer is Masayoshi Son. The site says it covers the company's philosophy, vision and strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations information, business segments and group companies, and sustainability (ESG) information.

The site also states that it presents the company's thinking in the era of the AI revolution, the efforts of group companies, and the possibilities that AI brings. That is the extent of the AI-related material on the site as harvested, and no specific AI products are tracked for the company.

The profile lists the company as publicly traded under the ticker SFTBF and gives an SEC CIK of 0001065521.
